description:
Hello, my name is Eric and I am producing tutorials that will help with all aspects of owning a home from general home including the following:
1. General Home Repair and Maintenance
2. Electrical Repair
3. Plumbing and HVAC Repair
4. Painting and Spackling
5. Automotive Repair
6. Lawn and Garden
Please let me know if there is a topic you would like for me to cover. I will do my best to work it into my upcoming videos.
